question: What services does CareKind provide?
answer: CareKind offers a comprehensive range of home care services including personal care, companionship, meal preparation, medication reminders, light housekeeping, mobility assistance, cognitive care for dementia and Alzheimer's, and end-of-life care. All our services are customized to meet each client's unique needs.

question: How much does home care cost?
answer: The cost of home care varies based on the level and frequency of services required. We offer flexible care plans ranging from a few hours per week to 24/7 care. Contact us for a free consultation and personalized quote. We can also help you explore funding options and financial assistance programs available in Nova Scotia.

question: Are your caregivers trained and screened?
answer: Absolutely. All our caregivers undergo comprehensive background checks, reference verification, and professional training that exceeds industry standards. Many of our team members hold certifications as Personal Support Workers (PSW) or Continuing Care Assistants (CCA). We prioritize both competence and compassion in our hiring process.

question: How quickly can care begin?
answer: We understand that care needs can arise suddenly. In many cases, we can arrange care within 24-48 hours of your initial consultation. For urgent situations, please call us at (902) 999-1445, and we'll do our best to accommodate your needs as quickly as possible.

question: Can I choose my caregiver?
answer: Yes! We carefully match caregivers with clients based on personality, preferences, interests, and care needs. If for any reason you're not completely satisfied with your caregiver match, we'll work with you to find someone who's a better fit. Your comfort and peace of mind are our top priorities.

question: Do you provide care on weekends and holidays?
answer: Yes, we provide care 7 days a week, 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays. Care needs don't take days off, and neither do we. Whether you need a few hours of respite care or full-time support, we're here whenever you need us.

question: What areas do you serve?
answer: We proudly serve Bedford, Halifax, Dartmouth, Sackville, Lower Sackville, Fall River, and surrounding areas throughout Nova Scotia. If you're unsure whether we cover your area, please give us a call—we're always expanding our service regions.

question: How do I get started?
answer: Getting started is easy! Simply call us at (902) 999-1445 or click the "Get Started" button to schedule a free, no-obligation consultation. We'll discuss your loved one's needs, answer all your questions, and create a personalized care plan that brings peace of mind to your family.
